svg.title: TYPE_REBALANCE_GARAGE -> PlanRebalanceGarageJob()
svg.desc: Keep the right share of bays in insert mode. The method asks ComputeBayRebalancingActions() which bays to switch, then runs the READY_FOR_INSERT and READY_FOR_RETRIEVE recipes with the same job_index.

g.text: Every sub-recipe uses the same job_index, so the first event of

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: B21's recipe waits for the leaves of B7's. Bays are rebalanced

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: one after another, not in parallel.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Per-bay failures are logged and skipped, and their partial

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: events stay. The job fails only if the initial replay fails; it may

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: succeed with no events at all.
